transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, it's a burning feeling when I pass water, and I'm needing to go ever so often. It's been bothering me for a few days now.
Could you tell me how much this is affecting your everyday life, and whether you’re allergic or have had a bad reaction to any medicines?
I've rather stopped going to the coffee morning at the flats, in case I can't get to the toilet in time. And yes, there's one antibiotic I can't take — it gave me a terribly itchy rash.
Could you tell me a bit about any medicines you take regularly or have started recently, and about any other health problems, operations, or hospital stays you’ve had?

I take some tablets for my thyroid each morning, and one for my thin bones once a week, and there's a cream from the hospital as well. My health's mostly just an underactive thyroid, and I had a water infection about a year back.
How much is the burning and needing to go often affecting your daily life?
The stinging's about five out of ten — uncomfortable, but I'm managing. It's really the needing to go that's the nuisance; it's about every hour in the day, and three or four times at night.
Could you describe where you feel the burning or stinging, and whether it moves or spreads anywhere else?
It's down below, when I pass water — it stings as the water comes out. It doesn't seem to spread anywhere else.
Since this started, have you noticed any other changes at all — for example in your appetite, sleep, weight, energy, bowels, or breathing?
My sleep's a bit broken with getting up in the night, but otherwise I've not noticed anything different — appetite, weight and breathing all seem the same as usual. My bowels are fine.
Have you noticed anything at all that seems to make the stinging or the frequent trips to the loo better or worse — things like drinks, food, moving about, or anything else?
I can't say I've noticed anything that makes it better or worse — not drinks or food or anything like that.

Besides the underactive thyroid and the water infection about a year ago, is there anything else you see a doctor or nurse about regularly, any other conditions your medicines are for — such as the daily thyroid tablets, the weekly tablet for thin bones, or the cream from the hospital — or any operations or hospital stays you've had?
The weekly tablet's for my thin bones, and the cream's from the hospital but I can't remember what it's called. Beyond the thyroid, that's about it — I've not had any operations.
Besides the thyroid tablets, the weekly tablet for your bones, and the cream, are you taking any other medicines at all — including anything you've started recently?
No, just those three — the thyroid tablets, the weekly bone tablet, and the cream. I've not started anything new recently.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
